description: Personal library of reusable Agent Skills for Claude Code, opencode, and other AI coding tools. Each entry is a self-contained skill folder with a SKILL.md.

skills.name: agy
skills.description: Delegate a coding, refactor, PR-review, or image task to the Antigravity CLI (agy) as an autonomous worker. USE WHEN delegating such a task to agy/Antigravity, or running the agy CLI.

skills.name: Art
skills.description: Generates images, diagrams, and visual output. USE WHEN producing any visual artifact.

skills.name: BackendDesign
skills.description: Reference for API design, database schema, and server architecture. USE WHEN designing an API, modeling a schema, or structuring a backend service.

skills.name: Build
skills.description: Implements plan tasks one at a time with compile and commit gates. USE WHEN building from a plan.

skills.name: CodebaseOnboarding
skills.description: Analyze an unfamiliar codebase and produce an onboarding guide — architecture map, entry points, conventions, starter CLAUDE.md. USE WHEN joining a new project or onboarding a repo.

skills.name: CodingStandards
skills.description: Language coding standards (TS, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Swift, Rust). USE WHEN writing, reviewing, or scaffolding code.

skills.name: ContextBudget
skills.description: Audit Claude Code context-window consumption across agents, skills, MCP servers, and rules, and produce prioritized token-savings recommendations. USE WHEN context feels bloated or you want to cut token usage.

skills.name: CreateCLI
skills.description: Generate a production-ready TypeScript CLI (3 tiers: parseArgs/Commander/oclif). USE WHEN create a CLI, command-line tool, or wrap an API. NOT FOR agent skills (use CreateSkill) or Python.

skills.name: CreateMcp
skills.description: Build a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with the official SDK — tools, resources, prompts, transport, and security. USE WHEN creating, scaffolding, connecting, or debugging an MCP server.

skills.name: CreateSkill
skills.description: Create, validate, and improve individual skills. USE WHEN create/validate/improve a skill or a skill isn't triggering. NOT FOR TypeScript CLI generation (use CreateCLI) or whole-library audits (use SkillForge).

skills.name: data-report-builder
skills.description: Turn a raw Excel/CSV dataset into a two-layer report — plain-language summary plus untouched raw data. USE WHEN someone shares a spreadsheet wanting a report, analysis, summary, or breakdown.

skills.name: docker-patterns
skills.description: Reference for Docker and Docker Compose local dev patterns. USE WHEN writing a Dockerfile or compose file, or containerizing local dev.

skills.name: FrontendAesthetics
skills.description: Visual direction and anti-slop gate — typography, color, motion. USE WHEN building any page/dashboard/UI, redesigning, design direction, or looks templated/AI-made. NOT FOR component logic or performance (use FrontendDesign).

skills.name: FrontendDesign
skills.description: Reference for building React/Next.js components, hooks, state, and performance. USE WHEN building components, hooks, state, or optimizing renders. NOT FOR visual styling, typography, or color (use FrontendAesthetics).

skills.name: GitHubOps
skills.description: Manage a GitHub repo via the gh CLI — hygiene, changelog, commit/push, PRs, releases, branch cleanup. USE WHEN clean up the repo, update the changelog, commit/push, open a PR, or cut a release. NOT FOR git branching/merge theory (use GitWorkflow).

skills.name: GitWorkflow
skills.description: Reference for git branching strategies, commit conventions, merge vs rebase, and conflict resolution. USE WHEN choosing a branching model, resolving conflicts, or setting commit conventions. NOT FOR running gh repo operations like push/PR/release (use GitHubOps).

skills.name: hygiene
skills.description: Audit ~/.claude for git, skill, code, and rules hygiene issues. USE WHEN auditing the Claude config, checking harness health, or cleaning up skills/hooks/rules.

skills.name: Iterate
skills.description: Refine a target across bounded passes toward a goal, with a state file and a hard exit condition. USE WHEN iterate, refine, loop, keep improving, or run until done.

skills.name: IterativeDepth
skills.description: Run 2-8 lens passes over the same problem to surface requirements and edge cases a single angle misses. USE WHEN exploring deeper, multi-angle analysis, or surfacing hidden requirements before building.

skills.name: opencode
skills.description: Delegate a coding, refactor, or PR-review task to the OpenCode CLI as an autonomous worker. USE WHEN delegating such a task to OpenCode, or running the opencode CLI.

skills.name: Orchestrate
skills.description: Decompose a spec into a dependency DAG, build units in parallel via delegation, review each in a separate context. USE WHEN orchestrating multi-unit or parallel work, or landing a large spec.

skills.name: pi
skills.description: Delegate a coding, refactor, or PR-review task to the Pi (pi.dev) CLI as an autonomous worker. USE WHEN delegating such a task to Pi, or running the pi CLI.

skills.name: Prompting
skills.description: Vendor-agnostic prompt-engineering standard library. USE WHEN authoring or refining a prompt, system message, skill, agent instruction, or rule file.

skills.name: Reflect
skills.description: Self-rate the just-finished output on five axes with evidence, then fix any gap scored ≤3. USE WHEN a non-trivial task finishes — 3+ files, a multi-step workflow, or 3+ debug attempts.

skills.name: Research
skills.description: Research a question at three depths (quick / standard / deep multi-agent fan-out), then synthesize cited findings. USE WHEN researching a topic, gathering sources, comparing options, or getting a cross-provider second opinion.

skills.name: SecurityReview
skills.description: Audits code for vulnerabilities and secrets. USE WHEN reviewing code for security issues.

skills.name: Simplify
skills.description: Post-implementation dead-code cleanup. USE WHEN running /simplify after finishing a feature or fix.

skills.name: SkillForge
skills.description: Audit the whole skill library for agentic readiness and instrument it with telemetry in bulk. USE WHEN auditing skills for autonomy, finding agentic gaps, or adding execution logging across skills. NOT FOR creating a single skill (use CreateSkill).

skills.name: Spec
skills.description: Explores code + LTM, then writes acceptance criteria. USE WHEN defining what to build before planning.

skills.name: StrategicCompact
skills.description: Reference for context compaction strategy and timing guidance. USE WHEN deciding when or how to compact a long session, or planning context strategy.

skills.name: TddWorkflow
skills.description: Test-first development workflow. USE WHEN writing a feature test-first or fixing a bug with TDD.

skills.name: Test
skills.description: Runs TDD for features and bug fixes. USE WHEN testing a new feature or fixing a bug with tests.

skills.name: Verify
skills.description: Run a build/type/lint/test/secret/diff gate ending in a READY / NOT READY verdict. USE WHEN verifying changes, before commit or PR, or as a quality gate.

skills.name: Workflows
skills.description: Index of composed skill chains — which skills to run, in what order, for a full job (ship a feature, research, build a CLI/MCP, author a skill, secure, release). USE WHEN deciding how to combine skills, asked 'what's the workflow for X', or chaining skills into one job.

workflows.name: api-feature
workflows.title: API feature
workflows.summary: A backend or API change, security-gated from design to PR.

workflows.name: autonomous-loop
workflows.title: Autonomous loop
workflows.chain: Iterate(target, goal, max) → [Verify + Reflect each pass] → GitHubOps:CommitPush
workflows.summary: Hands-off improvement of a target via Iterate, with a mandatory exit condition.

workflows.name: batch-build
workflows.title: Multi-skill batch build
workflows.chain: Spec → Orchestrate(Decompose → RunLayer → MergeQueue) → Verify → GitHubOps:PullRequest
workflows.summary: Build or refactor many skills at once, in parallel, each reviewed in isolation.

workflows.name: build-cli
workflows.title: Build a CLI
workflows.chain: [Research(API, if wrapping)] → CreateCLI → Test → Verify → GitHubOps:PullRequest
workflows.summary: Ship a TypeScript command-line tool, tier-picked and Verify-gated.

workflows.name: build-mcp
workflows.title: Build an MCP server
workflows.summary: Scaffold, secure, test, and connect a Model Context Protocol server.

workflows.name: canonicalize-skill
workflows.title: Canonicalize a skill
workflows.summary: Fix a skill's structure to conform to canon — naming, frontmatter, routing.

workflows.name: context-diet
workflows.title: Context diet
workflows.chain: ContextBudget → trim agents / skills / MCP / rules → Verify
workflows.summary: Cut context-window bloat across agents, skills, MCP, and rules — no feature change.

workflows.name: fix-trigger
workflows.title: Fix a skill's trigger
workflows.summary: A skill won't activate or mis-fires — repair its description and routing.

workflows.name: frontend-build
workflows.title: Frontend build
workflows.summary: Full frontend feature from spec through visual direction, components, assets, tests, to ship.

workflows.name: library-audit
workflows.title: Library-wide audit
workflows.summary: Whole-library health sweep — agentic readiness, telemetry, canon, repo hygiene.

workflows.name: new-skill-heavy
workflows.title: New skill — heavy
workflows.chain: IterativeDepth → Spec → CreateSkill → CreateSkill:TestSkill → Verify → GitHubOps:PullRequest
workflows.summary: Author a complex, multi-workflow skill whose shape isn't obvious yet.

workflows.name: new-skill-quick
workflows.title: New skill — quick
workflows.summary: Author a new skill with clear scope and a single capability. Daily path.

workflows.name: onboard
workflows.title: Onboard a codebase
workflows.summary: Get productive in an unfamiliar repo fast, then make the first change.

workflows.name: release
workflows.title: Release
workflows.summary: Cut a tagged version of the library — hygiene, changelog, GitHub release.

workflows.name: repo-hygiene
workflows.title: Repo hygiene
workflows.summary: Periodic cleanup of config and project repo — git, skills, rules, manifest drift.

workflows.name: research-to-build
workflows.title: Research to build
workflows.summary: Ground an unknown domain, library, or API before building against it.

workflows.name: research-to-buy
workflows.title: Research to buy
workflows.summary: Compare options before a purchase or adoption decision, then score a pick.

workflows.name: research-to-report
workflows.title: Research to report
workflows.summary: Deliverable is cited findings plus visuals, not code.

workflows.name: security-pass
workflows.title: Security pass
workflows.summary: Harden existing code before release — no new feature.

workflows.name: ship-fast
workflows.title: Ship fast
workflows.summary: Clear-enough scope; move fast and discover the details mid-flight.

workflows.name: spec-to-ship
workflows.title: Spec to ship
workflows.summary: Know exactly what to build; spec-driven build from criteria to PR.

workflows.name: ui-feature
workflows.title: UI feature
workflows.summary: A frontend change that looks intentional, not AI-slop — direction before components.
